purpose: Machine-readable comparison of the pinned taroz GSDC 2023 MATLAB pipeline and the native libgnss++ smartphone path. This record does not claim native 0.782-class performance.

native_inference_inputs: raw phone_data.mat with raw observation and sensor containers

cpp.contract: result/truth/sample/v5 coordinate inputs are not accepted; finite device-WLS ECEF columns are only an approximate raw-device seed

estimator.default_recipe: Eigen backend, P + ordinary TDCP + position/clock motion, max_iterations=8, no Doppler/carrier/DD factors

upstream.contract: remove invalid rows, compute satellite residuals/LOS, exclude residual outliers, compensate pseudorange using base observation, apply observation error model

native.contract: raw clock/P/L/D conversion, nav satellite state, SPP or finite device-WLS approximate seed, elevation/SNR/factor eligibility; no upstream base-observation compensation

matrix.gap: The raw boundary now reproduces the deterministic Android clock and observable equations, but the native path does not reproduce the complete upstream exobs/residual/base-compensation sequence.

upstream.contract: L1/L5 frequency arrays, signal-code mapping, wavelength and per-observation uncertainty; raw GPS/Galileo/other constellation filtering

native.contract: opt-in raw GPS L1 C/A + Galileo E1 C; FGO multi-constellation policy; unsupported signals are skipped

matrix.gap: L5 and the upstream full signal/code table are not represented by the first native raw converter; no claim of full upstream frequency parity.

upstream.contract: ENU x/v, seven-component clock vector c, clock drift d; IMU path adds Pose3 p and ConstantBias b

native.contract: default Eigen state has four position/clock components per epoch, optional velocity and ambiguity states; GTSAM has separate optional pose/bias paths

matrix.gap: Native default state ordering/clock representation is not a literal ENU seven-clock upstream state, and the smartphone entry point does not enable the IMU pose/bias state.

upstream.contract: robust pseudorange and Doppler factors, motion/clock factors, and ordinary TDCP; IMU version retains all GNSS factors

native.contract: default smartphone entry point enables pseudorange, ordinary TDCP and position/clock motion; explicitly disables undifferenced Doppler, carrier phase and DD

matrix.gap: The highest-impact missing graph family is the upstream no-base Doppler/velocity/clock coupling and full IMU graph. A prior corrected PDC experiment is sealed No-Go, so it must not be replaced by an unproven heuristic.

upstream.contract: clock jump noise/reset, receiver drift state, phone-specific TDCP offset and ADR sign policy, carrier arcs from LLI/clock/gap

native.contract: raw clock discontinuity and LLI are diagnosed; ordinary TDCP/carrier arc handling exists in the general FGO builder, but smartphone default disables carrier factors

matrix.gap: The native raw conversion carries reset metadata but does not yet port upstream multi-frequency arc preprocessing and phone-specific full graph use.

upstream.contract: Huber kernels with setting/phone-dependent thresholds plus observation/residual masks

native.contract: fixed native sigma/Huber configuration and factor eligibility; no setting-dependent upstream P/D/L mask parity in the smartphone entry point

matrix.gap: A native robust loss exists, but upstream mask/error-model values and their data-driven residual exclusion are not fully reproduced.

upstream.contract: initial GNSS run, IMU first run, final IMU run from prior result MAT, then per-route saved result and submission

native.contract: one in-memory full-series optimize call seeded by SPP; no result-MAT handoff and no upstream multi-pass/window schedule

matrix.gap: The native-only contract intentionally rejects result MAT, so an exact upstream state-handoff equivalent remains unimplemented and must be designed from raw observations.

upstream.contract: previous GNSS/IMU result or SPP-derived position/velocity, velocity-derived attitude, zero IMU bias and published mounting parameters

native.contract: SPP/last-valid seed path, native default FGO initialization; IMU attitude and bias initialization are not wired into this entry point

matrix.gap: Velocity/course and gravity/mounting initialization required by the upstream IMU recipe are absent from the raw native entry point.

upstream.contract: elapsed-time synchronization, gyro/acc interpolation, stop detection, gravity/preintegration covariance, mounting transform, Pose3/velocity/bias and bias-between factors

native.contract: device_imu is required and hashed by preflight, but the current smartphone FGO executable does not consume IMU samples or add CombinedImu/Imu factors

matrix.gap: This is a major missing component, but wiring it safely requires frame/time/preintegration parity and must follow the frozen no-base upstream contract rather than a smoother heuristic.

native.contract: Eigen default maxIterations=8 with native convergence threshold; optional GTSAM backend exists elsewhere

matrix.gap: Backend, iteration cap and stopping policy differ substantially; prior convergence-selector work was separately closed and cannot be used to tune this conversion.

upstream.contract: ENU to LLH, antenna position offset from attitude, exact sample key assignment, nearest/interpolation/extrapolation for missing result epochs, save result MAT

native.contract: finite geodetic CSV keyed by phone/time, atomic output and truth-free provenance; no sample coordinates or result-MAT postprocessing

matrix.gap: The native-only path intentionally does not implement upstream sample interpolation or antenna offset until raw estimator parity exists; output is suitable for development smoke only.

native_best_vs_external_oracle.interpretation: The imported precomputed MAT result is an external oracle, not native inference evidence. The gap therefore motivates a complete raw-data parity investigation but cannot identify a single tuned parameter.

partial_pdc_failure.interpretation: A superficially added Doppler factor path was structurally unstable; it is evidence against another heuristic PDC rewrite, not proof that the upstream factor is ineffective.

first_exact_component.name: raw Android clock and P/L/D observable conversion
first_exact_component.reason_for_selection: It is the earliest deterministic bridge from raw device_gnss.csv to native observations, is directly specified by gnsslog2obs.m lines 103-121 and 158-202, and can be proven without truth or result MAT.

equations.carrier: AccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters/(c/CarrierFrequencyHz), with the five-device published ADR sign correction

safety: duplicate supported satellite/signal rows fail closed
invalid zero/short transmit times are omitted according to upstream filtering
nonfinite and malformed raw fields fail closed
result/truth/sample/v5 coordinate columns are never accepted
result/truth/sample/v5 inputs are rejected before opening
